title: Use the Desired Output
text: The output strings should be the full soda substrings: "Coke", "Coke", and "Coca-Cola". A valid pattern should return those complete strings, not only pieces like "ke" or "ca-Cola".

title: Capturing Group Output
text: What text is captured by the group $$(ke|ca-Cola)$$ when matching "Coke"?

title: Check Option B
text: The pattern r"Co\w{2}\-?\w*" matches Co, then two word characters, then an optional dash, then more optional word characters. In the example string, this matches both "Coke" and "Coca-Cola".

title: Check Option C
text: The pattern r"Coke|Coca-Cola" uses alternation to explicitly match either desired substring. Since there is no capturing group, re.findall returns the full matched strings.

title: Eliminate Partial Matches
text: Option A uses a character class, so after Co it matches only one character from inside the brackets. Option D uses a capturing group, so re.findall would return only what is inside the parentheses, such as "ke" or "ca-Cola".
